quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x100000

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Regarding the Nameless Treasure...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: This thing you've brought... It looks pretty good. This pattern also seems quite old indeed. Hold on while I open it.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: There are some defects here and there, but if you're eager to have it taken off your hands, I can offer you a price. It'll be fair, but it won't be high.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: I just had a look at this one. These markings are definitely those of Liyue, and you can see inscribed here an anecdote about Azhdaha.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: They say that Azhdaha was a dragon spawned by a convergence of the spirits of Geo in Liyue, and that even Rex Lapis could not easily subdue it.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis thus summoned three adepti to his aid, and together they created a cavernous realm.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis then battled the creature, luring it into the realm, before ordering the adepti to seal the entrance, trapping Azhdaha within.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: The patterns on the thing you brought seem to describe the three adepti joining hands to create the cavernous realm.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: I guess that there should at least be three relics of this kind. Combining all three should give us the complete item.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: Well, I do trade in items of all kinds. A little general knowledge here and there couldn't hurt.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: Ah, but I digress. As I said earlier, there should be three of this item. One of them alone is likely not going to fetch a high price.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: But if you could gather all three, that would be a different story. But this looks to be quite ancient. Gathering all three might be too tall a task...

choices.text: Liyue truly is a mystical place...

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: Now this I'm not certain of, but a senior of mine once told me that Liyue is too large, and its history is, similarly, far too long.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: Don't be surprised if you find strange relics in Liyue. What we know of Liyue's lengthy history is but a single drop in the wide ocean.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Found all three.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: You... actually managed to put them together? Please, let me see... Indeed, these three patterns, when put together, do tell the story of Azhdaha.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: This crane must be the adeptus Mountain Shaper, and this deer might be Moon Carver. But this last one...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Eh? It seems like this pattern has been... intentionally ground away by someone, to the point where I can't make it out. Who was this third adeptus?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Forget it. These matters are beyond my knowledge. Regardless, this treasure is complete, and will definitely sell well.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: So, would you like to take it for a keepsake, or would you prefer to sell it to me? I'll pay you a pretty sum.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's yours.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Great. Please take this, then.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Still, why was the image of one of the three adepti marred?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Who made this thing, and who broke it and ground away the adeptus' image?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Right, it seems as if Soraya has arrived in Liyue. I could write her a letter... she would definitely be interested in this object.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll give it a go.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Alright. If you do manage to gather them, please bring them to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Regarding the Nameless Treasure...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: If my guess isn't off, the object you brought previously is one of three.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: It will only be complete once all three objects are gathered together.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: If you could find them all, I would be more than willing to make you a generous offer.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: I fear that they may be from too ancient a time, however, and that gathering them... could be difficult.
